_note: The kinds of health payment counted at a fraction over the years they cover: a premium paid in a lump sum for more than one year. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.126(8)(b), (10)(a), (10)(c) — rulebook DED-80D-009 (VERIFIED, S2): "Multi-year lump-sum premium is spread: the deduction for each relevant tax year is the appropriate fraction — numerator 1, denominator the number of relevant tax years"; the sub-sections' own words are not quoted in the repo. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80D(4A), "a deduction equal to the appropriate fraction" (sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B13). Spreading a kind this row does not reach is refused. Conditions only, on health.kind; provenance and introduction are DED-HEALTH-FAMILY-SENIOR's (W-156b2, D-347). Old regime only, as the health rows.
